decision.reason: All v2 followups remain far below the prior 2.1016 offline draft that itself failed endpoint quality/speed; endpoint runs would be roulette.
decision.next_action: Close current compact EAGLE v2 training branch. Revisit only with materially larger/diverse corpus, stronger initialization/training architecture, or source/runtime changes that address the previous endpoint corruption.
